what: With the section pinned to the screen, a long list flows from bottom to top, and each row is blurred and transparent at .8 screen height, darkens as it reaches .38 height, and at the last 15% the blur (3px) clears and it becomes sharp — a field list where only the line being read is crisp

options.[data-fx-part=list]: List to flow (children) — each child is a row
options.min: Fixed only at this width (px) or above, default 810 — when narrower, all lines show
